confidence_notes: The Langkawi restaurant, coffee and beer figures come from sparse crowd-sourced data last updated in October 2025. Cocktail and wine are rough estimates based on a local RM25 per drink guide relative to the domestic beer benchmark. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates and are less certain; no live lodging prices were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Langkawi's own cost-of-living observations for inexpensive and mid-range meals, cappuccino and domestic draft beer. Accommodation estimates reflect broad Malaysian island and Southeast Asian beach-destination budget-to-midrange patterns.
